Kanawha Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Becton Dickinson (BDX) by 23.67% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Kanawha Capital Management Llc bought 14,801 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.94% with the market. The institutional investor held 77,335 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $16.55M, up from 62,534 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kanawha Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Becton Dickinson for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $59.81B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.09% or $2.47 during the last trading session, reaching $224.66. About 1.44M shares traded or 19.19% up from the average. Becton, Dickinson and Company (NYSE:BDX) has risen 15.92% since May 5, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 4.37% the S&P500.
